purpose: Provide a clean research capability that delegates browser/research orchestration to COBRA without creating another scraper or taking ownership of source data.
rules: COBRA is the sole owner of browser automation and complex external research execution.
Research requests are normalized and versioned before delegation.
Research results are advisory/enrichment outputs and do not mutate CRM or source systems.
CRM, WCA and Identity flows must degrade gracefully when research is unavailable.
No original application is modified during migration.
Report Aziende remains deferred and connection-only until its standalone build phase.
